title: the database proxy's loopback relay stops redding the inference sole-path
intention: The database proxy's relay (dbproxy/forward.py) and its proof import socket to dial only the box's own Postgres on loopback; the sole-path mesh admits dbproxy/ as outline 11.3.8 says, and stays red for any other unreasoned door.
why: Measured 2026-11-18 on akiendelllinux at 053ca7cb9: with dbproxy v0 committed (ticket a22eb3c25ccd), test_host.py, test_import_sieve.py and test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py are red on 'dbproxy/forward.py imports [socket] - a SECOND door to the inference host', and build_inspector refuses a22eb3c25ccd's PROVED crossing on the same sole_path_holds finding. The relay dials only 127.0.0.1:<Postgres port>.
traces_to: Outline 11.3.8 and 11.4.1 (one door to the inference host; the database proxy is the database's door, not inference's); Law 4 (the sole-path rule stays physics).
how: CC's decision at outline 11.3.8 admits the database proxy whole, as web_operator/ and usage/ are: dbproxy/ joins the 'only' tuple at each seat usage/ holds (inspector.py _SOLE_PATH, test_host.py, test_import_sieve.py, test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py), each with a comment citing 11.3.8. A new inspector proof reads the real dbproxy row clean and catches an unreasoned socket importer beside it.

clauses.claim: the inspector's sole_path_holds reads the real dbproxy row clean, while dbproxy/forward.py still imports socket
in a seeded tree an unreasoned socket importer beside an admitted dbproxy is caught, and it is the only one caught
test_host.py, test_import_sieve.py and test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py are green with dbproxy admitted, and no dbproxy admission stands unentered (sole_path_admissions_are_entered)

decisions.text: D1: dbproxy/ joins the 'only' tuple at inspector.py's _SOLE_PATH, test_host.py (as cairn/devices/dbproxy/), test_import_sieve.py and test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py, each with a comment citing outline 11.3.8, CC's decision; the device is admitted whole, so no exemption_set entry is needed.
D2: the proof mirrors test_the_inspector_admits_the_usage_tool.py, one tooth per clause, os.sep pinned to '/'.

measured.saw: three sole-path seat proofs red on dbproxy/forward.py importing socket; a22eb3c25ccd's PROVED refused on sole_path_holds
measured.how: bin/cairn test over each seat proof, and close.sh's build_inspector reading, on akiendelllinux at 053ca7cb9
